about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: My Introduction
about.p1: I am studying Software Engineering at Uninter, along with other courses like JovemTech.
about.p2: Currently, I am attending the Jovem Tech program, offered by Inovase, focusing on IT modules and entrepreneurship with a Junior Programmer certification.
about.p3: I am eager to apply and expand my knowledge in this constantly evolving field, with a special focus on web development and systems analysis.

projects.title: Projects
projects.penguinsTitle: Pinguins na Lua — Flame in Freefall
projects.penguinsDesc: Solution developed by two teammates and me for the Flame in Freefall challenge at the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Supports searching and comparing PSI/NASA microgravity combustion experiments, with Gemini extraction validated against source evidence and scoring criteria computed in code.
projects.penguinsContribution: My contribution: UX, design system and visual identity, including the project's animations.

projects.flameDesc: Prototype for the Flame in Freefall challenge at the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Dashboard with simulated data, synchronized SVG charts, filters and CSV/JSON exports.
projects.flameContribution: I created this entire prototype to establish the project's visual identity, UI/UX and design system.
projects.margenDesc: Jewelry catalog with product detail pages, galleries and WhatsApp inquiries. Combines prerendered HTML with React hydration and responsive WebP images generated with Sharp.
projects.rentalsDesc: C# and Windows Forms application with SQLite persistence and BCrypt authentication. Separates the interface, services and repositories, with role-based permissions checked in the service layer.
